**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Help Us drive Data analytics and AI-Powered Business Transformation

**Are you passionate about data, analytics, and AI? Then you could be the one we are looking for.

**About the Role:

**We are looking for a skilled and proactive Data & AI Platform Engineer to help shape our next generation of digital capabilities.

In this role, you'll design and develop modern data platforms, integrations, and analytics solutions that empower automation, AI adoption and intelligent business processes across the organization.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, ERP specialists, process owners, BI developers, and application teams to transform data into actionable insights and create scalable solutions that unlock the value of AI.

This is more than a traditional data engineering role. You'll play a key part in building the infrastructure and capabilities that allow the business to leverage technologies such as Microsoft Copilot, AI agents, machine learning, intelligent automation, and advanced analytics.

**What You'll Do

****Build the Foundation for AI

**

• Design, build, and maintain enterprise data platforms, data warehouses, and semantic models.

• Develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines that make trusted data available across the organization.

• Ensure data quality, governance, security, and documentation are embedded into all solutions.

• Drive data accessibility.

**Enable Intelligent Applications & Automation

**

• Develop integrations between Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure services, manufacturing systems, APIs, and external platforms to gather data.

• Support the development of AI-enabled applications and business solutions.

**Empower Analytics & Business Decisions

**

• Deliver trusted datasets for reporting, dashboards, and self-service analytics.

• Design scalable data models that support both operational reporting and AI-driven insights.

• Partner with business stakeholders to turn challenges into data-driven solutions.

• Promote best practices for data and AI adoption throughout the organization.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, Data Warehouse Developer, Application Developer, or similar role.

• Strong SQL and data modeling

• Understanding of modern data engineering principles, governance, and securit

• Experience with one or more technologies like Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake or DBT, Azure Data Services, Azure Data Factory, SQL, Python, C#, Databricks (optional)

**Nice to Have

**

• Experience building and maintaining cloud-based data platforms and integration solutions.

• Experience with scalable data architectures and modern data pipelines.

• Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations or other ERP platforms.

• Experience with Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Copilot Studio.

• Understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or machine learning concepts.

• Experience exposing and managing enterprise data for AI consumption.

• Power BI experience.

**You ar****e someone who:

**

• Is passionate about solving business challenges with data and technology.

• Is curious about AI and emerging technologies.

• Can bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions.

• Combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

• Takes ownership and drives initiatives from idea to implementation.

• Enjoys collaborating across teams and influencing positive change

**What We Offer

**

• A central role in shaping our organization's AI and data strategy.

• The opportunity to build platforms that enable AI, automation, analytics, and digital innovation.

• Hands-on experience with modern Microsoft technologies, cloud platforms, and AI solutions.

• Significant influence on architecture, standards, and technology choices.

• Close collaboration with business and technology leaders.

• A flexible environment that encourages experimentation, learning, and innovation.

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

Do you enjoy keeping a team moving without getting in the way? Are you the kind of producer who loves making work life easier for your team through process? And are you also quite silly?

We're expanding one of our games and looking for a Senior Producer to help drive new content and features for our players. You'll work very closely with the executive producer and game director, supporting them in setting a clear production plan within time and budget constraints, while making sure the team has everything they need to do their best work.

You'll also be part of a cross-studio producer team where you can exchange ideas, challenge each other, and share knowledge and complementary skills.

**Here's What That Looks Like Day To Day

**

• Implement and refine production processes and tools, shaping how we work and grow as a studio

• Drive the project forward by removing roadblocks and keeping delivery dates realistic

• Facilitate the team’s day-to-day rhythm (stand-ups, planning, reviews, post-mortems)

• Plan updates, roadmaps, and marketing beats together with the leads, and communicate plans clearly to stakeholders

• Manage the project long-term: priorities, scope, timelines, risks, and follow-up

• Take on team and people responsibility, including 1:1s, development reviews, and salary conversations

Last, but not least: There's plenty of room to shape this role to fit you.

**Must-haves

**

• Experience going through at least one full game production cycle

• Experience as a producer on at least one shipped game

• Experience with live service and online games

• Experience working with external stakeholders

• A deep understanding of the game development process

• A strong belief in nurturing team wellbeing because a sustainable pace and motivation directly shape the quality of what ships

• Experience with people management (development talks, hiring, 1:1s) and team production (version control, stand-ups, sprints, reviews)

• You’re ready to tell us where we’re going wrong and help us improve

**What Always Matters To Us At Triband

**We've always believed that games are made by teams, not solo superstars, and good ideas can come from anyone. We love people who bring curiosity, generosity, flexibility, and strong opinions, especially when those opinions come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to validate ideas properly.

We also care a lot about experimentation. Sometimes the weird idea is not the right fit. Sometimes the weird idea is the entire game! The trick is being able to explore it together, learn from it, and not get too precious when the experience tells us we're wrong.

**Practicalities

**

• We don't offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role.

• We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• No crunch. People over deadlines.

• Our working language is English.

**We offer

**

• Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

• Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

• Pension plan and private health insurance.

• Endless amounts of coffee.

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?

**Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

Do you have a passion for helping clients navigate complex technology landscapes and turn architecture into a strategic advantage? Would you like to advise some of Denmark's leading brands on platform selection and future-proof architecture? If so, you may be the Senior Consultant we're looking for to join our Tech Enablement team in Copenhagen.

At Novicell, we help companies unlock their full digital potential. We combine creative thinking and technical expertise with strategic innovation to deliver tailored solutions that drive measurable business results. Our diverse team of specialists shares one ambition: to create outstanding customer experiences, drive growth, and challenge the boundaries of digital.

**Your Responsibilities

**As a Senior Consultant in our Tech Enablement team, you will play a key role in advising our clients on platform selection, architectural considerations, and how to ensure their technology setup can truly deliver on their strategic ambitions. You will work closely with our skilled tech leads, enterprise architects, and management consultants to help client’s future-proof their setup.

**Your role will include:

**

• Advising clients on platform selection and architectural strategy across areas such as commerce, CMS, search, personalization, martech, PIM, and marketing automation

• Guiding clients through architectural approaches — including MACH, composable, mixed, and suite-based architecture — to find the right fit for their business

• Building strong business cases that help clients decide on the right technical direction, weighing cost, risk, and long-term value against their strategic ambitions

• Defining roadmaps and transition plans that guide clients from their current setup to the right technical foundation, architecture, and platforms

• Translating corporate strategy into technology roadmaps that support long-term scalability and flexibility

• Driving technical pre-sales and playing an active role in winning new clients for Novicell

• Collaborating closely with tech leads, enterprise architects, and management consultants to deliver high-impact recommendations

• Acting as a trusted advisor to clients on how to future-proof their digital setup

**Your profile

**You are strategically minded, technically fluent, and commercially aware. You enjoy translating complex technical considerations into clear, business-relevant recommendations, and you're comfortable operating at the intersection of technology and strategy.

We expect you to bring:

• 3+ years of experience as an external consultant, from an agency, digital consultancy, or similar position

• Broad knowledge of technology architecture, including MACH, composable, and suite-based approaches

• Experience advising on one or more technology areas such as commerce, CMS, search, personalization, martech, PIM, or marketing automation

• Experience with or a strong interest in technical pre-sales and business development

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex challenges

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trust with technical and business stakeholders alike

• Curiosity and a continuous drive to learn and develop

• Fluency in Danish and English, spoken and written

**What We Offer

**At Novicell, you will step into an ambitious and professional environment where you can make a real impact. You will report directly to our Chief Strategy Officer and play a central role in advising some of the most exciting brands in Denmark and abroad on their technology strategy.

• Challenging and impactful projects from day one

• Excellent opportunities for professional and personal growth

• Inspiring colleagues who bring expertise and ambition to every collaboration

• Freedom and flexibility to shape your workday

• A collaborative culture built on our motto "Flink & Flittig" — professionalism, helpfulness, and dedication in everything we do, paired with an informal organization, a strong social culture, and plenty of activities and events across our offices

**Practical details

**

• Location: Copenhagen.

• Applications: Welcome in English or Danish.

• We review applications continuously and will close the process once the right candidate is found

• If you have any questions, please contact Kasper Madsen at kas@novicell.dk

We look forward to receiving your application!

R30528 Senior Group Financial Controller with consolidation focus, GN

Do you want to make your financial knowledge count? Imagine a possibility where you will be responsible for financial excellence by supporting and further developing the finance function in a global organization.

The team you will be part of

As a Senior Group Financial Controller at GN, you will join Group Finance and take a central role in ensuring accurate, timely and high-quality consolidated financial reporting.

Working closely with local finance teams, Group controllers and external auditors, you will drive the consolidation process while helping to simplify, standardise and strengthen the Group’s closing and reporting set-up.

Your contribution is appreciated and your responsibilities will include:

Consolidation, closing and Group reporting

You will own and drive the monthly, quarterly and annual Group consolidation process, ensuring a robust, efficient and well-documented close.

You will:

• Lead and coordinate the Group consolidation process, from entity reporting to consolidated reporting

• Review reporting from Group entities and perform consolidation entries, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation and other Group adjustments.

• Support the preparation of the consolidated financial statements

• Act as a on of the key point of contact for subsidiaries during the closing process, providing guidance on reporting and consolidation matters

• Support the transition of selected consolidation and reporting activities from external providers to an in-house Group Finance set-up

Process optimisation and reporting development

A key part of the role is to make the closing and reporting process faster, simpler and more reliable.

You will:

• Identify and drive improvements to closing, consolidation and reporting processes, including automation and standardisation opportunities

• Develop and maintain reporting packages in the consolidation system and process documentation

• Support the development and maintenance of consolidation and reporting systems and act as a key user where relevant

Financial controlling and collaboration

In close collaboration with other Group controllers, you will support the review and quality assurance of financial reporting from subsidiaries.

You will:

• Review and challenge selected financial information reported by subsidiaries

• Follow up on reporting issues, unusual developments and data-quality matters

• Contribute to the continued development of controls, governance and documentation within the Group reporting process

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

You are structured, proactive and analytical, with a strong sense of ownership and quality. You enjoy working with fixed deadlines, multiple stakeholders and continuous process improvement.

Moreover, you have a keen sense of quality, and you:

• Hold a master’s degree in finance, accounting, auditing, or a similar field

• Have several years of relevant experience from Group consolidation, financial reporting, or an international audit firm

• Have hands-on experience with consolidation processes and a good understanding of the flow from local entity reporting to Group reporting

• Have experience with financial reporting systems. Experience with systems such as OneStream, HFM or Microsoft Dynamics is an advantage

• Are comfortable working independently, driving tasks to completion and collaborating across functions and geographies

• Speak and write fluent English

We encourage you to apply

Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferrable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.

How to apply?

To apply, use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 19 November 2026. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

Join us in bringing people closer

GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhance the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 7 years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience.

• Experience building business cases through workshops or product demos to business executives.

• Experience developing partnerships with technical stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists).

• Experience positioning and selling technical solutions in data management, analytics, infrastructure, or AI/ML.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Experience working with Global System Integrators, hyperscalers, or ISVs to co-sell and accelerate pipeline.

• Experience closing large-scale data and AI transformation deals within specific regulated or high-growth enterprise verticals (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare/Life Sciences, Retail, or Manufacturing).

• Practical understanding of how modern cloud architectures, data governance (e.g., cataloging, lineage, compliance), and clean data estates enable AI and real-time analytics.

**About The Job

We enable them to transition to modern, unified cloud architectures that position data as the absolute foundation for AI success and power next-generation AI and intelligent applications. You will present demos that showcase how unified, well-governed data foundations power secure, hallucination-free AI agents and real-time experiences.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. This role offers flexibility to be based at a Danfoss Power Solutions location within the European time zone, enabling close collaboration with business leaders and finance teams across our global organization.

Partnering closely with the VP of the Valves & Pumps (VPS) Business Unit, you will drive transparency across performance, profitability, and risk, turning financial complexity into actionable insights that support confident decision-making and **profitable growth.

**

• Challenge business and plant leaders with data-driven insights, helping identify opportunities, improve profitability, and mitigate risks

• Coach and develop controllers across a global matrix organization, strengthening capabilities and fostering a high-performing controlling community

**What We're Looking For

**

• Proven track record of driving business performance through controlling, finance business partnering, or finance leadership within a manufacturing, industrial, or engineering environment

• Strong expertise in financial planning, forecasting, profitability analysis, performance management, and risk management

You will be part of a highly skilled, international finance community, with opportunities to influence senior stakeholders, contribute to global initiatives, and strengthen both people and organizational capabilities.

**Senior Business Consultant, Change Management

**Join NNIT as a Senior Business Consultant in Change Management

**Transformations succeed when people are ready, equipped and motivated to adopt new ways of working. As a Senior Business Consultant in NNIT’s working group for Change & Communication Consulting, you will help clients turn transformation ambitions into sustainable business outcomes.

Change & Communication Consulting is situated within the Life Science Project Consulting (LSPC) department. We deliver standalone and complementary services to project management, supporting clients across the people side of technology, process and organizational transformation.

You’ll join a professional, collaborative department that values quality and customer focus, while also making time for team socials, and casual get-togethers.

Location: This role will be based in Copenhagen, Denmark and will require onsite/office-based presence at customer sites as well as NNIT.

****The Role:

****As a Senior Business Consultant, you will lead change management workstreams in complex transformation programs. You will advise senior stakeholders, shape change strategies, and ensure that affected employees are prepared to adopt and sustain new processes, technologies, and ways of working.

You connect change plans to business benefit realization - ensuring adoption translates into measurable business outcomes, not just completed activities.

You will work closely with project managers, client teams, and colleagues across NNIT. Depending on the engagement, you may lead the change management track, provide strategic advisory support or contribute your expertise to a broader program.

Depending on the experience you bring, the successful candidate will be offered a position as Advanced, Senior, Principal or Managing Consultant.

****Your Responsibilities:

• Develop, implement and lead change strategies, plans, and activities in complex transformation programs.

• Assess organizational readiness, stakeholder needs and project health

• Build and coach sponsor coalitions to ensure visible, active leadership of the change

• Plan and coordinate communication, training and engagement activities

• Define and track adoption and readiness metrics

• Identify risks, resistance and adoption barriers, and develop practical responses

• Facilitate workshops with teams, functions and stakeholders across cultures.

• Translate transformation objectives into clear messages and actionable change activities

• Support the development of proposals, Request for Proposals, Statements of Work, client presentations, use cases, and thought leadership.

• Mentor and support consulting talent of tomorrow in junior-senior setups

• Contribute to the continued development of change and communication methods, tools and services.

Our approach is anchored in the Prosci® framework, while remaining adaptable to each client’s context, objectives, and needs.

****Your Qualifications:

****We are looking for an experienced profile who combines strong change management expertise with sound business understanding and the ability to work confidently with senior stakeholders.

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in delivering complex change management projects within the Life Science sector. You may have worked as a Change Manager, Transformation Consultant, Senior Consultant, Project Manager, or in a similar role.

**We Expect That You Will Have:

**

• Several years of experience with change management methods, tools, and processes

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• The ability to translate complex changes into clear actions and messages

• Experience with communication planning, training, and adoption activities

• Experience integrating change plans with a project's delivery methodology (agile, hybrid or waterfall) so change activities land at the right time

• Experience with advisory, presales, proposals, or commercial support

• Strong facilitation skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders

• Confidence working independently while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams

• Excellent English skills, both written and spoken

**It Is a Distinct Advantage If You:

**

• Have experience working in or for regulated industries such as life science or finance.

• Understand digital transformation in Regulatory, Safety, Clinical, or related life science areas.

• Are a Prosci® Certified Change Practitioner.

• Have experience from consultancy or customer-facing roles

• Are curious about human behavior, learning, culture and group dynamics.

• Are a well-liked colleague.

****Your Personal Profile:

****You are motivated by helping people and organizations succeed with change. You create clarity, build trust, and help stakeholders understand what is changing, why it matters, and how to move forward.

You are proactive, structured, and able to balance strategic direction with practical execution. You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally, and take responsibility for delivering results together with your team and customers.

****Why Join NNIT:

****At NNIT, you will join a company with strong roots in IT services, digital transformation, and regulated industries. We help customers develop, implement, and manage business critical solutions with high demands for quality, security, and reliability.

**We Offer:

**

• A professional and collaborative working environment

• Opportunities to work on meaningful projects for leading customers

• Skilled colleagues with strong business and technology expertise

• Room to grow your career and develop your consulting and change management capabilities

• A culture built on responsibility, respect, and delivering quality

****About NNIT:

****NNIT is a leading provider of IT services and consulting. We deliver solutions that support digital transformation and business critical processes for customers in Denmark and internationally. Our work is guided by a strong commitment to quality, trust, and long-term customer relationships.

**Apply now

**If you are ready to help organizations succeed with change, we look forward to hearing from you.

Please submit your CV and application through our recruitment system. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

****NNIT is a publicly listed company that specializes in IT solutions to life sciences internationally, and to the public and enterprise sectors in Denmark. We focus on high complexity industries and thrive in environments where regulatory demands and complexity are high. We advise on and build sustainable digital solutions that work for the patients, citizens, employees, end users or customers.

We invite interested candidates to apply, no matter their background.

And as part of the larger NTT DATA Business Solutions network, we can leverage cutting-edge AI technology, ensuring our clients receive the most advanced and efficient solutions available,” says Danny Haschke, SuccessFactors Consultant.

**Specifically, You Will

**

Department of Mathematical Sciences, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen

   

  Department of Mathematical Sciences (MATH) invites applicants for PhD stipends in mathematics.

  The start date is ordinarily September 1, 2027, but can be subject to negotiation.

  There will be PhD stipends available in:

   	
• Algebraic and Arithmetic Geometry, Applied algebra, Combinatorics, Geometric group theory, Geometry and Geometric Analysis, Number Theory, Representation Theory, and Topology as covered by the section Algebra & Geometry and  Copenhagen Center for Geometry & Topology (GeoTop).    	
• Classical Analysis, Descriptive Set Theory, Functional Analysis, Geometric group theory, Harmonic Analysis, History of Mathematics, Mathematical Physics, Operator Algebras, Partial Differential Equations, Quantum Information, Quantum Computation and Quantum Simulation as covered by the section Analysis and Quantum, the Centre for the Mathematics of Quantum Theory  and the Quantum for Life Center.   You are welcome to contact any member of the department to discuss research projects.

   

  Who are we looking for?

  We are looking for candidates within the field of Mathematics or nearby fields, whose background and research interests are a strong fit with the areas of mathematics above.

  About the department

  The department has about 50 permanent scientific staff members; around 60 PhD students and 35 postdocs. It has strong research groups in many areas of mathematics, and active PhD, postdoc, and visitors’ programs. Our buildings are located in central Copenhagen next to the central park Fælledparken. Our website http://www.math.ku.dk/english provides more information about the department and the research  conducted at the department https://www.math.ku.dk/english/research/.  We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment.

  You can find more information about the PhD program on the homepage http://www.math.ku.dk/english/programmes/ph.d/. 

   

  The PhD programme 

  Depending on your level of education, you can undertake the PhD programme as either:

  Option A: A three year full-time study within the framework of the regular PhD programme (5+3 scheme), if you already have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master’s degree.

  Option B: An up to five year full-time study programme within the framework of the integrated MSc and PhD programme (the 3+5 scheme), if you do not have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master’s degree – but you have an education equivalent to a Danish bachelor’s degree.

  ********************************************************************************

  Option A: Getting into a position on the regular PhD programme 

  Qualifications needed for the regular programme
 To be eligible for the regular PhD programme, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project, e.g. mathematics or closely related. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.

  Terms of employment in the regular programme 
 Employment as PhD fellow is full time and for maximum 3 years.

  Employment is conditional upon your successful enrolment as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant.

  Terms of appointment and payment according to the agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

  Option B: Getting into a position on the integrated MSc and PhD programme

  Qualifications needed for the integrated MSc and PhD programme 

  If you do not have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master’s degree, you might be qualified for the integrated MSc and PhD programme, if you have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish bachelor’s degree. Here you can find out, if that is relevant for you: General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.  

  Terms of the integrated programme
 To be eligible for the integrated scholarship, you are (or are eligible to be) enrolled in one of the faculty’s master’s programmes in Mathematics or Quantum Information Science.

  Students on the integrated programme will enroll as PhD students simultaneously with completing their enrollment in this MSc degree programme.

  The duration of the integrated programme is up to five years, and depends on the amount of credits that you have passed on your MSc programme. For further information about the study programme, please see: www.science.ku.dk/phd, “Study Structures”.

  Until the MSc degree is obtained, (when exactly two years of the full 3+5 programme remains), the grant will be paid partly in the form of up to 48 state education grant portions (in Danish: “SU-klip”) plus salary for work (teaching, supervision etc.) totalling a workload of 150 working hours per year. A PhD grant portion is currently (2026) DKK 7.426 before tax.
 
 When you have obtained the MSc degree, you will transfer to the salary-earning part of the scholarship for a period of two years. At that point, the terms of employment and payment will be according to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State (AC). The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

   

  Responsibilities and tasks in both PhD programmes

   	
• Complete and pass the MSc education in accordance with the curriculum of the MSc programme  (ONLY when you are attending the integrated MSc and PhD programme) 	
• Carry through an independent research project under supervision 	
• Complete PhD courses corresponding to approx. 30 ECTS / ½ FTE 	
• Participate in active research environments, including a stay at another research institution, preferably abroad 	
• Teaching and knowledge dissemination activities 	
• Write scientific papers aimed at high-impact journals 	
• Write and defend a PhD thesis on the basis of your project   We are looking for the following qualifications and experience:

   	
• Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project 	
• Relevant work experience 	
• Other relevant professional experience, including publications (if any) 	
• A curious mind-set with a strong interest in Mathematics 	
• Good English skills    

  Application and Assessment Procedure

  Your application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  Please include: 

   	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page) 	
• Curriculum vitae including information about your education, experience, publications (if any), language skills and other skills relevant for the position 	
• Original diplomas for Bachelor’s or Master’s and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in another language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. 	
• Reference letters (if available; letters can be uploaded as part of the application or sent to hr-math@adm.ku.dk by the reference person).   When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

   

  Application deadline: 

  The deadline for applications is 1 November 2026, 23:59 GMT+1. 

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After deadline, a number of applicants will be selected for academic assessment (shortlisted) by a committee of unbiased experts. You are notified whether you will be passed for assessment.

  An assessment committee will assess the qualifications and experience of the shortlisted applicants with respect to the research area, skills and other requirements. The assessors will conclude whether each applicant is qualified. The assessed applicants will have the opportunity to comment on their assessment. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Questions
 For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.

  General information about PhD study at the Faculty of SCIENCE is available at the PhD School’s website: https://www.science.ku.dk/phd/.

  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the surrounding community and invites all regardless of personal background to apply for the position.

Architect, build, and scale AI systems that hold up in production

Take ownership of how AI is architected, built, and scaled across our products. You will design the agentic systems at the core of our pension and advisory platforms, with a focus on reliable and responsible AI.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help lead our newly established AI team, working on our Life product for pension companies. The team is focused on the practical and responsible use of AI and is still in its early stages, so as a senior member you will play a defining role in setting the technical foundation, design patterns, and ways of working that the rest of the team builds on.

You will work closely with the AI Team Lead and Chief Architect, who own the overall architecture, helping shape the design within that direction. You will also be part of an agile team with a flat structure, where collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning are central to the culture.

This role is primarily about designing and building agentic and LLM systems end to end, with a meaningful share of your time spent owning how we evaluate them and prove they hold up. It suits someone with 5+ years of relevant experience who wants to move beyond implementation into designing AI systems, and who enjoys raising the bar for the engineers around them.

Why this matters

This is core infrastructure, not edge tooling. Our Life product runs policy and capital administration for some of Europe’s largest pension providers, including PensionDanmark and APG, and is on track to support more than 8 million members and over €800bn in retirement assets.

The AI you design must meet that bar: fast and innovative, but also accurate, secure, and reliable enough for systems that people depend on for their financial security in retirement. Building it well and being able to prove it works, are two sides of the same job.

What you’ll do

As a senior member of the AI team, you will help shape how we build with Large Language Models and agentic systems across our products, contributing to high‑level design decisions, turning ambiguous business problems into robust system designs, and ensuring high‑quality coding standards and design. You will be hands‑on, with a real say in the architecture, standards, and technical judgement that guide the team.

In practice, you will:

Help shape the technical direction

• Contribute to the AI tech stack across our products: help define the high‑level system design, reference architectures, and design patterns the team builds on.

• Help shape AI strategy: identify where AI can create genuine value, frame the trade‑offs, and feed into a coherent, prioritised technical roadmap that fits our wider platform.

• Inform major architectural decisions: model and framework selection, build‑versus‑buy, and how AI components fit into our existing Java platform, integrate with surrounding systems, scale, and stay maintainable over time.

• Reason about trade‑offs in the open: weigh latency, cost, accuracy, security, and reliability, and explain and defend those choices to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Architect and build (hands‑on)

• Design LLM systems end to end: from retrieval, agent orchestration, and data pipelines through to deployment and monitoring.

• Design and build agentic systems: single‑ and multi‑agent, covering orchestration, tool use, action groups, knowledge‑base integrations, and patterns such as routing, delegation, parallelisation, and result aggregation for complex, reliable production workflows.

• Engineer RAG pipelines that connect agents to internal structured and unstructured data.

• Drive quality through design: prompt strategy, system prompts, and memory systems that produce hallucination‑resistant outputs with strong relevance and faithfulness.

• Make cost‑aware architectural choices: balancing latency, cost, and quality across model selection and orchestration patterns so what we ship is sustainable at scale.

• Set the standards for prompt strategy, RAG, orchestration, and cost management that the wider team adopts.

Evaluate and prove

• Build evaluation frameworks: eval sets, golden datasets, and LLM‑as‑judge pipelines, with offline regression suites wired into CI and online evaluation on production traces.

• Evaluate the whole agent, not just the answer: task success, trajectory and tool‑use correctness, and RAG faithfulness and grounding, so you know whether failures come from retrieval, reasoning, or generation.

• Measure what gates shipping: relevance, faithfulness, latency, cost, and reliability across repeated runs, turned into quality gates the team ships against.

Collaborate and grow the team

• Collaborate and mentor: work with the AI Team Lead, Chief Architect, senior developers, and product teams to translate business needs into working, well‑tested solutions, and support more junior engineers as the team grows.

What we’re looking for

You bring a strong technical foundation, hands‑on depth with modern AI tooling, and the judgement to design systems that hold up in the real world. You don’t need deep expertise in every area below, but we do expect real depth in agentic systems and AI architecture, backed by a solid grasp of how to evaluate what you build.

Required

• A master’s degree in computer science or a similar field, preferably with an AI focus.

• 5+ years building software, with significant hands‑on work applying Large Language Models.

• Strong proficiency in a statically typed, object‑oriented language, Java or C# (we build in Java). Python is welcome for demos, evaluation tooling, and experiments, but it is not our production language.

• Deep experience designing, building, and operating agent‑based systems, with hands‑on use of one or more orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangChain/LangGraph, Microsoft Agents, Claude Agent SDK, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel).

• A track record of designing and building AI systems, including how the components fit together, scale, and are maintained over time.

• Solid, practical experience with prompt strategy, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), and the cost considerations of LLM usage and model selection.

• Working knowledge of LLM and agent evaluation: eval sets, LLM‑as‑judge, and the metrics that distinguish a good system from a confident‑but‑wrong one (faithfulness, relevance, task success, latency, and cost).

• Experience designing AI or backend systems that fit into a larger production platform, collaborating with senior engineers and architects to align on a shared technical direction.

• Strong communication skills to explain and defend architectural trade‑offs to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Nice to have

• Experience building automated evaluation pipelines or CI gates for AI systems.

• Familiarity with observability and tracing tooling for LLM applications (e.g. LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, Braintrust).

• Familiarity with LLM evaluation, automation, and red teaming.

• Broader machine learning experience.

• Hands‑on experience building and integrating MCP servers.

• Experience working in regulated or high‑reliability domains such as finance, insurance, or healthcare.

Who you are

You are a confident, hands‑on engineer who takes ownership of complex and sometimes undefined problems, and who is just as comfortable designing a system as proving it holds up. You think in systems, balance pragmatism with quality, and care about building things that work in production rather than just in a demo. You lift the people around you, stay open to feedback, and bring strong technical judgement of your own. You are curious, persistent, and result‑oriented.
